title: Delivery retry and reconnect do not roll back world state
preconditions: A MESSAGE event is accepted in a cycle batch and same-cycle MESSAGE_DELIVERED is emitted before observation projection when recipient is active
Client disconnects after ACCEPT but before OBSERVE delivery

assertions: World sequence and digests unchanged by reconnect alone
Undelivered observations may redeliver without re-reducing events
No ledger rewrite or sequence reuse
Acknowledgements are cumulative per logical delivery stream and mutate delivery bookkeeping only
Resume outside the bounded redelivery window returns RESUME_POSITION_EXPIRED or RESUME_POSITION_INVALID without world mutation
Post-delivery observations from the same cycle may include delivered messages when visibility permits
